svg.text: Blueprint — Vertical Agent Orchestration & Memory Map
Who decides, who researches, who critiques, when memory is read or written, and where a human takes control
The founder supplies the unfinished idea, constraints, geography, goal and the research lanes
Creates an anonymous owner session, validates required fields and shows progress without
BP-API-01 · Start or resume a run
Applies scope and safety checks, restores owner context and persists a durable project/run
Turns confirmed onboarding answers into problem framing, goals, personas-to-test, constraints
and initial assumptions. No web research is needed.
Reloads canonical state, applies budgets and policy, chooses the next eligible route and
re-evaluates after every observation or founder decision.
Builds the dependency graph, releases only eligible tasks and dispatches independent research
lanes in parallel—not a fixed A → B → C chain.
Each receives the same foundation contract and returns structured findings, evidence IDs,
Checks source relevance, recency, claim support, contradictions and missing evidence. Rejected
Computes the transparent 40 / 30 / 30 score, coverage and confidence. It never invents demand,
Challenges completeness, consistency, unsupported certainty and usefulness. It may request
one bounded revision through the Supervisor.
Combines only audited findings into a versioned Research Blueprint, explicit actionables, open
The founder reviews the verdict and selected idea improvements, then chooses proceed, revise,
rerun, override with reason, or pause. Stage 2 cannot unlock without this decision.
Stage 2 Prove & Design → Stage 3 Action Blueprint
Approved context routes into assumptions and risk, operating model, validation plan and
deterministic financial scenarios. Stage 3 supplies milestone-level MVP, first-customer and
distribution guidance—never executes actions for the founder.
Versioned Blueprint + financial scenarios + next moves
Every section stays inspectable while later work runs. The founder can compare versions,
inspect evidence and request a targeted rerun through HITL.
On tool or model failure: retry
results for review, or fail safely. It
The system improves by storing accepted observations, founder corrections and route outcomes, then reloading them on the next decision.
It does not self-train model weights, store raw chain-of-thought, or let Mem0/Pinecone override Supabase as the source of truth.
Solid arrows = normal control/data path · Dashed arrows = recovery, revision or retrieval path · External writes remain human-approved
